regime_context: The detector shows an extremely narrow leadership tape: only Banks (cn_banks) cross the absolute-trend eligibility gate, and its backtest verdict is explicit that the gate did NOT hold here on China A-shares history — the tape mean-reverts and whipsaws the gate. Cross-sectional momentum is an attention/focus lens only (rank-IC ~0), rotation timing has no validated edge, and the sole edge (drawdown control) is negated on this market, so any lean must be very low conviction and framed as a conditional, not a prediction.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme still eligible under the absolute-trend gate (eligibility=true, durability_bar 0.75, hurst_tag 'trend'), with the widest breadth in the sample (0.611) and the highest headline weight (0.25, cash 0.75). This supports a continued-trend conditional lean rather than a valuation or narrative call. Crowding_z 1.6 is a SIZE-DOWN caution, not a fade — per guardrails I cap conviction and exposure, I do not treat the crowding flag as a sell. The lean is a bet that the established trend persists until the trend-gate itself turns negative.
evidence: crowding_z 1.6 (size-down caution only, not a fade)
theses.dissent: China A-shares are documented in this market's backtest as mean-reverting; the absolute-trend gate 'did_NOT_hold_here', so the trend label itself has no validated drawdown edge. A mean-reversion snap would hurt the leader most, and the crowding flag means any unwind is disproportionate.

It is also crowded (crowding_z 1.35) and ranks below Banks in the same Financials & Value cluster. This is a relative-underweight conditional: while the theme has trend texture, the detector's own trend discipline has de-risked it, so relative to the eligible leader it sits outside the trend envelope.
theses.dissent: The theme still has 'trend' hurst tag and the sample's best breadth, and the eligibility gate itself has no forward edge on this market. Being ineligible could simply be a lagged re-acceleration signal, and underweighting a trending, broad theme is the classic whipsaw failure on a mean-reverting tape.
